title: What's New:  Flexible Update Management (2024 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Version 25 major changes to update periods
New update cycle phases and timeline
Minor updates and new flexibility features

features.name: 5-month update period for major releases
features.description: The update period for major releases is increased from 60 days to 5 calendar months, providing more flexibility for customers to schedule their updates.
caveats: Only Microsoft localized environments in public preview

features.name: Shortened grace period with weekly attempts
features.description: The grace period is shortened to one month where updates are scheduled every week and can be rescheduled to earlier dates but not later dates, with the environment attempted to update four times total.
caveats: Cannot postpone updates to later dates during grace period

features.name: Enforced update period with extension uninstall
features.description: After the grace period, an enforced update period begins where incompatible extensions are automatically uninstalled as part of the update process, with no option to postpone.
caveats: Incompatible extensions will be uninstalled automatically

features.name: Opt-out for automatic minor update scheduling
features.description: A new environment-level setting allows customers to opt out of automatic scheduling for minor updates, making them available but not automatically scheduled.
features.status_evidence_quote: at that point also the admin Center changes will come so we'll introduce the opt out for automatic scheduling
caveats: Only comes in general availability phase
Limited to environments that opt out

features.name: Ability to skip minor versions
features.description: Customers can now fall behind multiple minor versions and select a target version when scheduling updates, allowing them to skip intermediate versions.
features.status_evidence_quote: at that point it will be possible to change the update Target version as well so it'll be possible to skip versions
caveats: Not possible during public preview phase for version selection

features.name: Create environments on any supported version
features.description: When creating new environments in the admin center, users can now select from any supported version instead of only the latest version.
caveats: Tenants without any BC environment will still create on latest version

features.name: Admin Center API changes for update scheduling
features.description: API endpoints in the admin center will change to reflect the new update management flexibility, requiring updates for partners who automate update scheduling.
features.status_evidence_quote: will slightly change to reflect the new flexibility um those changes are coming in March
caveats: Breaking changes expected for partners using telemetry

features.name: Telemetry signal changes for update events
features.description: Telemetry signals related to environment updates will change to reflect the new flexible update management properties, affecting partners who alert or report on these signals.
caveats: Partners need to update their monitoring
